title: Funding a feasibility study for East Maui Water Authority
summary: On September 24, 2024, the committee voted eight ayes, with one member excused, to file Bill 122 (2024) and Bill 134 (2024), setting both bills aside. The draft contract tied to the matter was for analysis of a possible purchase of the East Maui irrigation system.
